# Lustre Studio

> Lustre Studio is a 100% custom web design and SEO agency serving businesses across the United States and United Kingdom. We build bespoke, conversion-focused websites engineered to rank higher on Google and AI search engines. Founded in 2025.

## Entity Information

- **Official Name**: Lustre Studio
- **Brand Handle**: lustrestudio
- **Website**: https://lustrestudio.uk
- **Email**: hello@lustrestudio.uk
- **Founded**: 2025
- **Type**: Remote Web Design & SEO Agency
- **Markets Served**: United States, United Kingdom
- **Social**: Instagram @lustrestudiouk, Pinterest @lustrestudiouk

## Core Services

- [Custom Web Design](https://lustrestudio.uk/services/web-design.html): 100% bespoke website design from scratch. No templates. Mobile-first, conversion-focused, SEO-optimized. Starting from $1,500.
- [Website Development](https://lustrestudio.uk/services/website-development.html): Clean-code, performance-first front-end development. Hand-coded HTML/CSS/JS with sub-2-second load times.
- [Local SEO](https://lustrestudio.uk/services/local-seo.html): Google Maps optimization, NAP citation management, local keyword targeting, and Google Business Profile optimization.
- [Technical SEO](https://lustrestudio.uk/services/technical-seo.html): Core Web Vitals optimization, crawlability audits, schema markup, site architecture, and indexation fixes.
- [AI Search Optimization](https://lustrestudio.uk/services/ai-search-optimization.html): AEO (Answer Engine Optimization) and GEO (Generative Engine Optimization) to get cited by ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, and AI Overviews.
- [Conversion Rate Optimization](https://lustrestudio.uk/services/conversion-rate-optimization.html): Data-driven CRO strategies, user flow optimization, CTA testing, and layout improvements to increase conversions.
- [Landing Page Design](https://lustrestudio.uk/services/landing-page-design.html): High-converting standalone pages for PPC campaigns, product launches, and lead generation funnels.
- [WordPress Development](https://lustrestudio.uk/services/wordpress-development.html): Custom WordPress themes and development. No bloated page builders. Performance-optimized, SEO-ready.
- [Shopify Development](https://lustrestudio.uk/services/shopify-development.html): Custom Shopify stores with bespoke themes, optimized checkout flows, and e-commerce SEO.
- [Website Redesign](https://lustrestudio.uk/services/website-redesign.html): Modernize your website without losing SEO rankings. Full visual and structural overhaul.
- [Website Maintenance](https://lustrestudio.uk/services/website-maintenance.html): Ongoing monthly support, security updates, performance monitoring, and content updates.
- [Google Business Profile Optimization](https://lustrestudio.uk/services/google-business-profile-optimization.html): Complete GBP setup, category mapping, review strategy, and Map Pack ranking.
- [Custom Web Tools](https://lustrestudio.uk/services/custom-tools.html): Bespoke web applications, interactive calculators, client portals, and booking engines.

## Industries Served

- [Web Design for Dentists](https://lustrestudio.uk/industries/dentists.html): Patient-focused dental websites with online booking and dental SEO.
- [Web Design for Plumbers](https://lustrestudio.uk/industries/plumbers.html): Lead-generating plumbing websites with emergency call CTAs and local SEO.
- [Web Design for Lawyers](https://lustrestudio.uk/industries/lawyers.html): Authoritative law firm websites with practice area pages and attorney SEO.
- [Web Design for Coaches](https://lustrestudio.uk/industries/coaches.html): Personal brand websites for life coaches and business coaches with course integration.
- [Web Design for HVAC Companies](https://lustrestudio.uk/industries/hvac.html): Service-focused HVAC websites with emergency call CTAs and service area pages.
- [Web Design for Roofers](https://lustrestudio.uk/industries/roofers.html): Roofing lead generation websites with before/after galleries and local SEO.
- [Web Design for Cosmetic Clinics](https://lustrestudio.uk/industries/cosmetic-clinics.html): Premium med spa and aesthetic clinic websites with treatment galleries and booking.
- [Web Design for Car Detailing](https://lustrestudio.uk/industries/car-detailing.html): Auto detailing websites with package pricing, before/after galleries, and local SEO.

## Differentiators

1. **100% Custom Design**: Every pixel built from scratch — zero templates, zero page builders
2. **Conversion Architecture**: Websites engineered for revenue, not just aesthetics
3. **AI Search Optimized**: Structured for citation by ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, and AI Overviews
4. **Dual-Market Expertise**: Deep experience serving both US and UK businesses
5. **Performance-First**: Sub-2-second load times, 90+ Lighthouse scores
